intent_en: To illustrate the substantial growth in median executive pay at large US companies since the 1970s.
previous_intent: To illustrate the growing disparity in compensation between corporate executives and typical workers at large US companies since the 1970s.
narration_support: Since the 1970s, median pay for executives at the nation's largest companies has more than quadrupled even after adjusting for inflation according to researchers.
chart_support: Line chart overlaid on a US map showing a sharp upward trend in pay values from the 1970s to the 2000s.
evidence_note: The narration also mentions a decline in worker pay, but the chart only visualizes the increase in executive pay, supporting the first part of the narration.
